selectedCaption: The wheel is straight. The car isn't. A pull has more than one cause, and they're not equally urgent. Only pulls when you brake? That can point to the brakes. Pulls all the time? That can point to alignment — or just uneven tire pressure. Check pressure first. It's free, and it's often the answer. Worth checking before it becomes a bigger fix.
voiceoverScript: The wheel is straight. The car isn't. A pull like this has more than one cause. Only pulls when you brake? That can point to the brakes. Pulls all the time? Worth checking before it becomes a bigger fix. Send this before you book anything. Stop by — we'll check pressure and take a look, free. Nick's Tire & Auto, 17625 Euclid Avenue, Cleveland.
